extraction.NOTES: Cover/transmittal letter from L. W. Page, Superintendent, Fort Berthold Indian Agency, Elbowoods, North Dakota, dated December 27, 1928, responding to Circular No. 2464. States that a careful search of old files found only a few applications; two patents were found to have been issued without the application of the allottees and full reports were submitted for those cases. Where no records pertaining to patents were found, notation 'no application on file' was made, though superintendent notes this does not positively mean no applications were made and that original applications may be found in Office files. A list of all patents issued to allottees on this reservation prior to 1921 was prepared with notation as to whether an application is on file.
